description: This file contains the implementation of the 'BankingService' interface, providing methods for managing customers, accounts, transactions, and transfers within a banking application. It uses Spring Framework annotations and conventions, and includes business logic for customer and account operations.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of banking service operations handling customers, accounts, transactions, and transfers with database interaction and business logic.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customers as domain objects.

methods.name: findAllAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves all account information as a list of domain objects.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates and saves a new customer based on provided customer details.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds and returns customer details by customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer's information, including contact and address details.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves account details given an account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new account associated with a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Performs fund transfer between two accounts for a customer, with transaction recording.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Fetches all transactions associated with a specific account.
